_note: Emergency cards for Survive the Sol. Each day the player picks 3 of 5 offered cards and can use each one once when a danger hits. dangerTypes = the dangers this card is RIGHT for (full effect). Used on another danger = half effect. effect.reduce = share of the danger's damage the card blocks. cost = what using the card costs (bars: power / life / rad, or a special cost). icon = SVG path (24x24 stroke icon). science = a real science line; source = where it comes from.

cards.title: Radiation Shield
cards.science: Thick layers of Moon soil (regolith) can block a lot of radiation.
cards.source: NASA – space radiation and lunar regolith shielding research

cards.title: Water Wall
cards.science: Water is very good at stopping radiation, so bases can keep water in the walls.

cards.title: Storm Shelter
cards.science: During solar storms, ISS astronauts move to the most shielded parts of the station.
cards.source: NASA – International Space Station space weather procedures

cards.title: Quick Repair
cards.science: Astronauts go on spacewalks to repair the outside of the ISS.

cards.title: Duck & Cover
cards.science: The ISS has layered shields to protect it from tiny space rocks called micrometeoroids.
cards.source: NASA – ISS micrometeoroid and orbital debris shielding

cards.title: Battery Pack
cards.science: The ISS stores solar energy in batteries so it has power when it flies through Earth's shadow.
cards.source: NASA – International Space Station electrical power system

cards.title: Power Save
cards.science: Spacecraft switch off machines they do not need, so the power lasts longer.

cards.title: Oxygen Boost
cards.science: The ISS makes fresh oxygen by splitting water with electricity.
cards.source: NASA – ISS Environmental Control and Life Support System

cards.title: Clean the Panels
cards.science: The Mars rovers Spirit and Opportunity got extra power when wind blew dust off their solar panels.
cards.source: NASA – Mars Exploration Rovers (Spirit and Opportunity)
